headline.lastSession: From your last therapy session to an active life
headline.therapyEnded: Therapy ended. Your movement goes on.
headline.stillYours: Training is still yours, whatever your body has been through

hero.body: Azm measures how you move today, builds an exercise plan that fits your medical condition, coaches every session through your phone camera, then measures again so you can see for yourself how your movement changes.

example.test: Arm raise to the side, right

loop.title: How Azm works
loop.intro: Four steps that start from your own movement and come back to it with every new check.

measure.title: Measure
measure.body: Azm measures your movement for your own tracking, with a short check through your phone camera that sets your own starting point.

prescribe.title: Plan
prescribe.body: Clear medical rules, not AI, choose the movements and the amount that fit your medical condition. You can start from a photo of your medical report.

coach.title: Coach
coach.body: In every session the camera counts your reps and corrects you to your own range, with a calm Arabic voice beside you. The video never leaves your device.

prove.title: Measure again
prove.body: Every four weeks we measure again so you can see the change, compared only with yourself.

close.title: Your body changed. Your resolve did not.
close.body: Start free, for yourself or for someone in your family. Every session is saved so you can follow your training yourself.

range.title: We measure only your affected joints
range.body: Your medical condition and your body map decide which joints we measure, then we compare how far they move with what is typical for people of your age and sex.

points.move: You move as far as you can without pain, and the camera reads the angle of the movement.
points.result: The result of each movement appears in plain words, and your body map is coloured by the results.
points.again: With each new check you see where your movement stands, between your starting point and typical.

range.alt: Fahd seated raising his right arm in front of his phone with a gold arc showing the movement path

walk.title: We read the way you walk, step by step
walk.body: If you walk, even with an aid, we measure the timing of your steps on a walking pad or on level ground, and compare your right side with your left. Then we tell you what your walk may suggest.

points.reasons: We link what we see in your walk to your range results and your medical condition, to name the possible reasons.
points.sure: We tell you how sure we are about each observation.
points.program: We add stretches to your program for what may be tight, and strengthening for what may be weak.

walk.alt: Fahd walking at an easy pace with his phone beside the path

coach.title: A coach that talks with you as you move
coach.body: An AI voice coach that joins your checks and workouts, and never overrides your plan or the safety rules. It stays off until you turn it on, and every question it asks has buttons on the screen.

points.max: At the end of a movement, it asks whether that is as far as you can go.
points.hurts: It hears you when you say “it hurts”, so it notes your pain and asks no more of you.
points.pain: It asks about your pain when you say a movement hurts, and repeats the instructions whenever you ask.

coach.alt: Latifa raising her right arm as soft voice rings reach her from the phone
